k:HH.Dlc.Gizmo.BuyDesc: Buy absolution, mercy or rank for a colonist. Prices follow their ideoligion's stance. The silver comes from colony stock or their pocket.
k:HH.Dlc.Gizmo.ChooseFaithDesc: Dedicate this altar to an ideoligion. Its followers among your guests will come here to pray.
k:HH.Dlc.Gizmo.FundDesc: Where your colonists' payments go. The deity keeps them for good; a faction of the same faith warms to you (+1 goodwill per 500 silver, at most +5 per quadrum).
k:HH.Dlc.Noble.Arrived: A {0} and retinue arrive for {1} days.
k:HH.Dlc.Noble.BilletText: The Empire orders you to lodge a {0} and {1} retainers for {2} days. They expect a bedroom worthy of their rank ({3}). You will receive about {4} silver for expenses. Refusing costs goodwill and honor.
k:HH.Dlc.Noble.Left: The noble party leaves. Payment: {0} silver.
k:HH.Dlc.Noble.OfferText: A {0} with {1} retainers asks to stay for {2} days and will pay about {3} silver if they are comfortable. They expect: {4}. Declining costs nothing.
k:HH.Dlc.NothingOffered: their faith offers nothing for sale
k:HH.Dlc.Reason.CapColony: the colony has bought this already this quadrum
k:HH.Dlc.Reason.CapIdeo: the ideoligion has had enough of this for this quadrum
k:HH.Dlc.Reason.NoFresh: no fresh wound of up to 10 hit points
k:HH.Dlc.Reason.NoGuilt: no memory of a broken commandment
k:HH.Dlc.Reason.NotAThing: their faith has no such thing
k:HH.Dlc.Reason.PsylinkMax: psylink is already at its limit
k:HH.Dlc.Reason.RankHeld: already holds this rank or a higher one
k:HH.Setting.dlc.traitSpawn: New traits appear on generated people
k:HH.Setting.dlc.traitSpawn.Desc: Lucky, Unlucky, Born host and the other Hearth & Harbor traits can show up on newly generated pawns. Existing pawns keep theirs. Off: only added by hand or editor.
k:HH.Setting.dlc.traitRarity.Desc: Multiplier on how often our traits are rolled for new pawns (1 = same rarity as most vanilla traits).
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_Hospitable.label: hospitable
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_Hospitable.description: Carriers are warm without trying. Guests find them easy to be around, and hosting comes quicker to them.
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_AddictionProofReward.d: The reward circuit of the brain barely reacts to risk and chance. Gambling rarely becomes a habit.
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_Compulsive.label: compulsive
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_Compulsive.description: An overactive reward circuit. Gambling is a little more fun, and a lot harder to put down.
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_DexterousFingers.label: dexterous fingers
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_DexterousFingers.descr: Unusually fine hand control: shuffling, dealing and palming come naturally.
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_RefinedPalate.label: refined palate
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_RefinedPalate.descript: A tongue that tells good cooking from merely edible. Cooks lift dish quality more often; as a guest the carrier expects more and tips more.
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_NumberSense.label: number sense
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_NumberSense.descriptio: Numbers arrange themselves. Croupiers, cashiers and bank clerks with this gene work as if three skill levels better.
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_TirelessSmile.label: tireless smile
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_TirelessSmile.descript: The smile muscles do not tire. Serving at tables and counters drains rest far more slowly.
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_SilverTongue.label: silver tongue
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_SilverTongue.descripti: A voice that makes any price sound like a bargain. Guests expect slightly less and loyalty comes cheaper.
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_HighRoller.label: high roller
d:GeneDef/HH_Gene_HighRoller.description: Carriers feel most alive when the stakes are high. They bet bigger, enjoy it more and tip generously, but they are also harder to pull away from the table.
d:IssueDef/HH_Indulgences.label: indulgences
d:IssueDef/HH_PaidAscension.label: paid ascension
d:PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_NotAThing.de: Nobody here has ever thought of selling forgiveness. Nothing to buy, nothing to object to.
d:PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Abhorrent.de: Forgiveness is not a commodity. Anyone who sells it should be driven from the temple.
Buying absolution is a shabby habit. It works, but nobody should be proud of it.
d:PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Accepted.des: A fair offering for a fair mercy. The price is on the sign.
d:PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Sacred.label: sacred
d:PreceptDef/HH_Indulgences_Sacred.descr: Paying one's dues is a sacrament. The faithful get a discount, and a cheap conscience is a duty.
Rank is earned here, never bought. Nothing to buy, nothing to object to.
Faith is not for sale. Anyone who sells rank has already lost it.
d:PreceptDef/HH_PaidAscension_Disapprove: A bought rank is a hollow rank. The congregation sees through it.
d:PreceptDef/HH_PaidAscension_Accepted.d: Rank can be bought, at the posted price, like everything else of value.
d:PreceptDef/HH_PaidAscension_Sacred.des: The ladder is the faith. Every rung bought is a rung climbed, and the ones below look up with respect.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_FaithForSale.stages.0.de: They sell forgiveness out in the open, like turnips.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_FaithNotForSale.stages.0: Faith is not for sale. And yet there is a price list.
It worked, but I paid for it, and I know exactly what that makes me.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_PaidMyDues.stages.0.desc: My dues are paid. The books are clean and so is my conscience.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_StingySoul.stages.0.desc: A whole quadrum without paying my dues. I should be ashamed.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionMood.stages.0.d: I have taken the first step of the ladder.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionMood.stages.1.d: The second rung. People start to use my title.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionMood.stages.2.d: The third rung. The view is already better.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionMood.stages.3.d: The last rung. Nobody above me but the sky.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_AscensionDisapproval.sta: They bought that rank. It means nothing.
They have climbed higher than I have. I respect that.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.0.des: A modest corner for prayer. Better than nothing.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.1.des: A quiet, decent chapel. I could pray here.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.2.des: A fine chapel of my own faith, far from home. I am grateful.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.3.des: A beautiful chapel with proper seats. My faith has been seen.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_PlaceToPray.stages.4.des: Splendid. They built a house for my god here. I will remember this.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_HereticShrine.stages.0.d: There is a shrine to a false faith on our land.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_HereticShrine.stages.1.d: A shrine to a false faith, tolerated by my own people. Shameful.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_HereticShrine.stages.2.d: They built a shrine for heretics next to our home. I cannot bear it.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_ShrineRespected.stages.0: We make room for other faiths. That is how it should be.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_ShrineRespected.stages.1: A shrine for every faith that passes through. That is how it should be.
d:ThoughtDef/HH_ShrineRespected.stages.2: Why do we build shrines for people who believe the wrong things?
d:Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Ind_ExpressAbs: A stamped slip that wipes one memory of a broken commandment. The priest does not ask what you did.
d:Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Ind_MinorMercy: A blessed bandage, sold at the price of two doses of medicine. Heals one fresh wound of up to 10 hit points.
d:Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Ind_UnshakenFa: A framed certificate that says you never doubted. Raises certainty by ten percentage points.
d:Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Ind_GreaterMer: A priced miracle. Heals one lasting scar or old wound for good.
d:Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank1.desc: Pay the entry fee and become a Seeker. A start, nothing more.
d:Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank2.desc: Rank II, Adept. From here on the holder may sell indulgences at the altar to guests and visitors of other houses.
d:Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank3.desc: Rank III, Luminary. Light enough to be noticed from far away.
d:Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Asc_Rank4.desc: Rank IV, Ascendant. The top of the ladder, for those who can afford the view.
d:Hearth.IndulgenceDef/HH_Ind_ReformTith: A voluntary tithe towards the next reform of a fluid ideoligion: one reform point.
d:IncidentDef/HH_NobleStay.label: noble stay
d:IncidentDef/HH_NobleStay.letterText: A noble party asks for lodging.
d:IncidentDef/HH_ImperialBilleting.label: imperial billeting
d:ThingDef/HH_GuestAltar.label: guest altar
d:ThingDef/HH_GuestAltar.description: A small altar for the faith of travellers. Pick an ideoligion you know: guests who follow it find a place to pray, donate to the temple fund, and may buy indulgences here. Your own colonists of other faiths may object.
d:StatDef/HH_ServiceQuality.label: service quality
d:StatDef/HH_ServiceQuality.description: How pleasant this person is to be served by. Added to the satisfaction of guests they talk to, and read by shops, kitchens and the front desk.
d:StatDef/HH_HostingLearn.label: hosting learning
d:StatDef/HH_HostingLearn.description: Multiplier on the social experience gained while hosting guests.
d:StatDef/HH_GuestExpectation.label: guest expectation
d:StatDef/HH_GuestExpectation.descriptio: Added to what a guest expects from a stay. Positive means harder to please. Charm and good manners lower it; a refined palate raises it.
d:StatDef/HH_GamblingJoy.label: gambling joy
d:StatDef/HH_GamblingJoy.description: Multiplier on the joy this person draws from gambling.
d:StatDef/HH_GamblingAddiction.label: gambling addiction chance
d:StatDef/HH_GamblingAddiction.descripti: Multiplier on the chance that gambling becomes an addiction. Zero means this person never gets hooked.
d:StatDef/HH_Dexterity.label: sleight of hand
d:StatDef/HH_Dexterity.description: Skill levels added to fine hand work at tables: dealing, shuffling, and house cheating.
d:StatDef/HH_TableSkill.label: counting skill
d:StatDef/HH_TableSkill.description: Skill levels added when working as croupier, cashier or bank clerk.
d:StatDef/HH_FraudDetection.label: fraud detection
d:StatDef/HH_FraudDetection.description: Multiplier on noticing forged chips, cheating guests and short-changing.
d:StatDef/HH_TheftChance.label: theft in their room
d:StatDef/HH_TheftChance.description: Multiplier on the chance that something is stolen in a room this person looks after.
d:StatDef/HH_BrawlRisk.label: brawl risk around them
d:StatDef/HH_BrawlRisk.description: Multiplier on the chance of a quarrel turning into a fight in this person's room.
d:StatDef/HH_RumorSpread.label: rumour spread
d:StatDef/HH_RumorSpread.description: Multiplier on how far stories about the house travel, good or bad.
d:StatDef/HH_CareProgress.label: care progress
d:StatDef/HH_CareProgress.description: Multiplier on patient and rehab progress while this person looks after them.
